name: PlayIT
notes: PlayIT Cross-Platform Download Centre & Zero-Cost Distribution release. Features instant device detection, direct Android APK download, native macOS Universal DMG installer, Windows installer, Linux AppImage, and zero-install iOS/Desktop Progressive Web App with seamless automatic background updates.

android.autoUpdate: In-app check with direct download and system package installer prompt
android.instructions: Tap 'Download for Android'. When downloaded, tap the file to install. If your browser asks for permission to install unknown apps, tap Settings and allow it.

ios.badge: No App Store Account or Apple ID Required
ios.autoUpdate: Automatic background Service Worker cache invalidation on application launch
ios.instructions: Install PlayIT on your iPhone or iPad directly from Safari:
pwaSteps: Open PlayIT in Safari on your iPhone or iPad.
Tap the Share button (square with arrow pointing up) at the bottom.
Scroll down and tap 'Add to Home Screen', then tap 'Add' in the top right.

macos.autoUpdate: Tauri auto-updater with SHA-256 package validation
macos.securityNotice: PlayIT is distributed as independent open software. Because it does not use a paid $99/year Apple Developer ID signature, macOS Gatekeeper may show an unverified developer notice on first launch. Right-click PlayIT in Applications, click Open, and confirm once. Or simply use the PlayIT Web App in Safari/Chrome!

windows.securityNotice: Distributed directly without a paid Microsoft Store EV certificate. If Windows SmartScreen displays 'Windows protected your PC', click 'More info' and 'Run anyway'.

linux.securityNotice: Make the file executable: right-click -> Properties -> Permissions -> check 'Allow executing file as program', or run chmod +x in your terminal.
